# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions of dollars)
# From the table - Net excise taxes (35) column
monthly_values = [
    7463,  # Oct 2017
    7240,  # Nov 2017
    6867,  # Dec 2017
    6168,  # Jan 2018
    5878,  # Feb 2018
    7849,  # Mar 2018
    6905,  # Apr 2018
    7325,  # May 2018
    7343,  # June 2018
    7716,  # July 2018
    8154,  # Aug 2018
    16079  # Sept 2018
]

# Calculate mean
n = len(monthly_values)
mean = sum(monthly_values) / n
print(f"Monthly values: {monthly_values}")
print(f"Number of months: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD)
mad = sum(abs(x - mean) for x in monthly_values) / n
print(f"Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD): {mad}")
print(f" MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
print(f" In millions of dollars")
EOF
